Note: A TEAE is defined as an AEs that emerges or worsens (ie increase in CTCAE grade) on/after the first WTX-330 dose and within 30
days of the last WTX-330 dose or the start of a new cancer regimen, whichever occurs earlier.
Note: Adverse Events are graded with CTCAE Grade 5.0, except for Cytokine Release Syndrome which is graded with ASTCT Grade.
Note: Each subject is counted only once in each category. TEAEs related to study drug are events reported with ‘Definitely Related’,
‘Probably’, ‘Possibly’ or missing in the relationship.
